assigned_model_vendor_role.rationale: Touches the owner's live tree; atomicity errors here are data loss.

IMP-0023.evidence_requirement: TWO independent signals: (1) a full install into a throwaway HOME, with the resulting file set diffed against the IMP-0010 projection; (2) an interrupted install (process killed mid-activate) followed by an independent inspection proving the tree matches exactly one of the two valid states. Idempotency is a third check: a second install produces zero file mutations, verified by mtime+hash census.
IMP-0023.question_or_target: Implement `install` as a three-phase transaction: stage the payload to a side directory, verify it in place (schema, digests, permissions), then activate by an atomic swap — so an interruption at any point leaves either the old state or the new state, never a half-installed tree. Re-running install on an already-current install must be a no-op that reports so.
IMP-0023.retry_policy: two-strikes-then-pivot; never retry an interrupted install without first running the journal recovery (IMP-0028)
IMP-0023.reviewer_requirement: Independent Phase-11-style confirmer who runs the install from a fresh clone and fresh profile, not from the implementer's tree.
tests_required: tools/plugin/tests/test_install_transaction.py::test_clean_install_matches_projection
tools/plugin/tests/test_install_transaction.py::test_kill_mid_activate_leaves_valid_state
NEGATIVE CONTROL: corrupt a staged file and assert activation refuses
IMP-0023.title: Transactional `install` command (stage, verify, activate)

assigned_model_vendor_role.rationale: Merge algorithms have exact expected outputs; a fixture matrix is the oracle.

assigned_model_vendor_role.rationale: A small, exactly-specifiable primitive with a byte-level oracle.

IMP-0035.evidence_requirement: TWO independent signals: (1) for a CRLF/LF pair of the same logical file, raw sha256 differs while normalised sha256 matches; (2) the byte-length delta equals the line count exactly, computed separately — this arithmetic identity is the control proving the difference really is EOL and nothing else.
inputs: ground/cc-reality finding: every byte delta equalled the file's line count exactly
IMP-0035.question_or_target: Implement the comparison primitive used by every drift and integrity check: hash content after normalising line endings, and report EOL-only differences as a distinct class rather than as content drift. On this box 55 of 88 rules files differ by EOL alone; treating them as drift produces a 55-file false-positive wall that hides the 28 real ones.
IMP-0035.reviewer_requirement: Reviewer must confirm binary detection precedes normalisation, or normalisation corrupts binary comparisons.
tests_required: tools/plugin/tests/test_eol_normalised_hash.py (CRLF/LF pair, CR-only pair, mixed-EOL file, binary passthrough)
NEGATIVE CONTROL: a one-character content change must still differ after normalisation
binary files must NOT be normalised (assert a PNG hashes identically raw and normalised)
IMP-0035.title: EOL-normalised content hashing to eliminate phantom drift

assigned_model_vendor_role.rationale: The packet's content determines whether a human can decide correctly; that is a judgement about what evidence matters.

IMP-0036.evidence_requirement: TWO independent signals: (1) a packet generated for each of the 28 measured content-differing rules files, each containing non-empty unique-line sets for at least one side; (2) an independent re-extraction of those unique lines by a different differ, requiring set equality. A packet claiming a side has unique content when it does not is a detector failure.
inputs: ground/baseline residual: 'which side is authoritative' was explicitly unsettled for 28 files
IMP-0036.question_or_target: For every file classified DIVERGED, emit a reviewable decision packet containing both unique-line sets, the last repo commit touching the path, the live mtime, and a recommended action — and make the tooling refuse to act on a DIVERGED file until a recorded decision exists. Provenance, not size, decides authorship.
IMP-0036.reviewer_requirement: Reviewer must confirm mtime is never used as the authorship signal (a documented wrong heuristic on this estate).
tests_required: tools/plugin/tests/test_divergence_packet.py::test_packet_contains_both_unique_sets
NEGATIVE CONTROL: acting on a DIVERGED file without a recorded decision must be refused
assert the recommendation field is advisory and machine-distinguishable from a decision
IMP-0036.title: Diverged-file decision packet (never auto-resolve)
